name: ChEMBL
tagline: Bioactive molecules and drug-like compound data from EMBL-EBI
description: ChEMBL is a manually curated database of bioactive molecules with drug-like properties. It brings together chemical, bioactivity and genomic data to aid the translation of genomic information into effective new drugs.

auth.details: No authentication required for public data access

use_cases: look up bioactive compounds by ChEMBL ID
search molecules by SMILES or InChI
retrieve bioactivity assay data for a target
get drug mechanism of action information
